# 1 Enoch Chapter 66 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**66:1** And from there I went to another place, and he showed me to the west another great and high mountain of hard rock.

**66:2** And there were in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth. How smooth are the hollow places, and deep and dark to look into.

**66:3** Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said to me: These hollow places have been created for this very purpose — that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble here, yes, that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here. And these places have been made to receive them until the day of their judgment and until their appointed period — until the period when the great judgment comes upon them.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. All three translators converge closely. 'Children of men' preserved as the Ge'ez formula (all three translators agree). Raphael's name preserved untranslated. 'Hollow places' is the preferred rendering over PNEUMA's 'hollows' — the Ge'ez makwan suggests carved-out dwellings. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
